candidate_evidence.quote: Patients receive selpercatinib PO BID on days 1-28.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: II. To obtain information about the tolerability of selpercatinib (LOXO-292) in children and adolescents with relapsed or refractory cancer.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Profiling Changes in Tumor Genomics: Will explore approaches to the profiling changes in tumor genomics over time through evaluation of circulating tumor deoxyribonucleic acid.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive selpercatinib PO BID on days 1-28.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Selpercatinib may block the growth of cancer cells that have specific genetic changes in an important signaling pathway (called the RET pathway)

source_quote.quote: Selpercatinib for the Treatment of Advanced Solid Tumors, Lymphomas, or Histiocytic Disorders With Activating RET Gene Alterations, a Pediatric MATCH Treatment Trial

coder_notes: NCI-COG Pediatric MATCH subprotocol; ages CHILD and ADULT (up to 21 years) with a basket of paediatric solid tumours; glioblastoma is not named (only malignant glioma and WHO grade 2 glioma in conditions), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Imaging procedures are not agents. ctDNA tumour-genomics profiling is an exploratory objective not linked to RET, so no biomarker row and target engagement unclear. Eligibility requires assignment to this arm based on an actionable (RET) alteration.
